evidence.title: AI presentation software for modern church teams | Pewbeam

name: Pewbeam
summary: AI church presentation app that detects Bible verses in live sermons and projects them in seconds.
description: Desktop app for churches that transcribes sermons in real time and projects the referenced Bible verse within seconds, with semantic search over 31,000+ verses, 20 Bible translations, animated verse presentations, themes, NDI/HDMI broadcast output and AI sermon notes. Free Explorer tier plus Plus ($14/mo) and Core ($30/mo) plans; runs on macOS, Windows and Linux.
contains: real-time sermon transcription with automatic Bible verse detection
semantic search over 31,000+ Bible verses, including paraphrased references
20 Bible translations and animated verse presentations
AI sermon notes with Markdown, PDF and DOCX export
